key_findings: SNI induces spinal ferroptosis (Fe2+, ROS, MDA up; GPX4, SLC7A11, GSH down), loss of GAD65+ GABAergic interneurons and mitochondrial dysfunction; intrathecal calcitriol reverses these and mechanical allodynia via VDR, an effect partly abolished by RSL3.

Spinal neuronal PKCα/NOX4 signaling is upregulated after SNI; its inhibition (BIM-1) relieves allodynia and ferroptosis, its activation (PMA) in naive rats induces them, and calcitriol suppresses PKCα/NOX4.
